$meta.note: Semantic tokens only (primitives excluded). Typography entries follow the same mobile-base + desktop-diff convention as the Magento typography-plugin.js, fused at the 769px breakpoint. Regenerate with generate-tokens.py whenever alligo-design-tokens publishes a new version -- do not hand-edit values.

accent-dark.description: Purpose: Reserves the dark accent companion for the active concept brand. Use only for approved brand treatments explicitly requiring the darker accent; current evidence is documentation-only.

accent-default.description: Purpose: Provides the primary accent color for the active concept brand. Suitable for approved brand expression, highlighted actions, heroes, navigation graphics, cards, and custom icons.

accent-hamburger.description: Purpose: Provides the concept-specific color for the hamburger menu icon. Reserved for that navigation role; no current ECO usage is recorded.

accent-light.description: Purpose: Provides the light accent companion for the active concept brand. Suitable for table headings, highlighted sections, dashboard navigation, and low-intensity brand surfaces.

background-primary.description: Purpose: Provides the default application background. Suitable for the root page background and other primary page-level canvases; use a surface token for raised or contained content.

background-secondary.description: Purpose: Provides an alternative application background that separates page areas from the primary background. Suitable for My Account pages and other page-level contexts intentionally using a secondary background.

border-action-1.description: Purpose: Provides the primary action border on light surfaces. Suitable for secondary buttons and established outlined action treatments.

border-action-2.description: Purpose: Provides the inverted action border on dark surfaces. Suitable for secondary inverted buttons and approved light-bordered actions.

border-action-3.description: Purpose: Provides a translucent border for system-style actions. Suitable for system buttons, toggled system controls, and related interactive containers.

border-danger-default.description: Purpose: Provides the strongest danger-status border. Suitable for strong danger notifications, notice cards, and established error-state boundaries.

border-danger-weak.description: Purpose: Provides a medium-emphasis danger border. Suitable for weak danger notifications and danger badges.

border-danger-weaker.description: Purpose: Reserves the lightest danger border for weaker danger treatments. No current ECO usage is recorded; use only when explicitly required.

border-dark.description: Purpose: Provides a subtle boundary within dark surfaces. Suitable for footer dividers, collapsibles, system buttons, dark badges, and related dark compositions.

border-disabled.description: Purpose: Identifies disabled bordered controls and components. Suitable for disabled buttons and form elements; avoid for enabled low-emphasis borders.

border-focus.description: Purpose: Identifies keyboard or programmatic focus. Suitable only for focus indicators on interactive controls; never use it as a decorative blue border.

border-hover.description: Purpose: Indicates hover on bordered interactive elements. Suitable for buttons, product cards, drawers, forms, and quantity pickers.

border-information-default.description: Purpose: Provides the strongest informational-status border. Suitable for strong information notifications, blockquotes, and approved information boundaries.

border-information-weak.description: Purpose: Provides a medium-emphasis informational border. Suitable for weak information notifications and information badges.

border-information-weaker.description: Purpose: Provides the lightest informational border. Suitable for weaker information notifications and low-emphasis information containers.

border-input-control-default.description: Purpose: Provides the default outline for discrete input controls. Suitable for checkboxes, radio buttons, toggles, steppers, sliders, and related controls.

border-input-default.description: Purpose: Provides the default outline for input components. Suitable for text fields, selects, date pickers, search, autosuggest, text areas, multiselects, and quantity inputs.

border-primary.description: Purpose: Provides the default visible border and divider color. Suitable for cards, tables, drawers, buttons, collapsibles, and standard component boundaries.

border-secondary.description: Purpose: Provides subtle separation without strong prominence. Suitable for tables, forms, drawers, tags, toast notifications, and supporting dividers.

border-selected.description: Purpose: Clearly identifies a selected item or control. Suitable for selected forms, pickers, boxed links, tables, and other established selection states.

border-selected-hover.description: Purpose: Indicates hover on an already selected item. Suitable for selected form controls, image choices, and color swatches with a distinct hover state.

border-selected-weaker.description: Purpose: Provides a subtle selected-state boundary. Suitable for selected product cards, associated variant tables, and established stepper states.

border-success-default.description: Purpose: Provides the strongest success-status border. Suitable for strong success notifications, dashboard cards, and positive-status boundaries.

border-success-weak.description: Purpose: Provides a medium-emphasis success border. Suitable for weak success notifications and success badges.

border-success-weaker.description: Purpose: Reserves the lightest success border for weaker success treatments. No current ECO usage is recorded; use only when explicitly required.

border-tertiary.description: Purpose: Provides a compact, low-emphasis separator between closely related items. Suitable for short dividers, grouped values, forms, headers, and navigation sections.

border-warning-default.description: Purpose: Provides the strongest warning-status border. Reserved for strong warning notifications and approved high-emphasis warning boundaries; verified component use is currently limited.

border-warning-weak.description: Purpose: Provides a medium-emphasis warning border. Suitable for weak warning notifications and warning badges.

border-warning-weaker.description: Purpose: Reserves the lightest warning border for weaker warning treatments. No current ECO usage is recorded; use only when explicitly required.

icon-inverted.description: Purpose: Provides the default high-emphasis icon color on dark surfaces. Suitable for dark headers, navigation, inverted controls, and other dark contexts.

icon-primary.description: Purpose: Provides the default high-emphasis icon color on light surfaces. Suitable for functional icons, form controls, notifications, and primary iconography.

surface-00.description: Purpose: Provides the lightest solid neutral separator surface. Suitable for subtle section separation and vertical scrollbar tracks where a border is inappropriate.

surface-02.description: Purpose: Provides the lightest solid neutral separator surface. Suitable for subtle section separation and vertical scrollbar tracks where a border is inappropriate.

surface-05.description: Purpose: Provides a very light neutral surface. Suitable for product badges, weak neutral badges, progress visualization, and subtle supporting surfaces.

surface-10.description: Purpose: Provides a subtle neutral surface above the lightest levels. Suitable for progress tracks, drawers, carousel surfaces, and other approved low-emphasis fills.

surface-100.description: Purpose: Provides the darkest neutral surface. Suitable for headers, footers, tooltips, dark badges, link tiles, and established progress visualization.

surface-15.description: Purpose: Provides a light supporting surface between surface-10 and surface-20. Suitable for established tracks and limited section canvases; avoid as a default background.

surface-20.description: Purpose: Provides a light neutral surface with clear separation from lower neutral levels. Suitable for weak neutral badges, cards, carousel areas, forms, and stepped treatments.

surface-30.description: Purpose: Reserves the neutral 30 level for semantic surface use. No approved usage is currently recorded, so use only after its intended role is confirmed.

surface-40.description: Purpose: Reserves the neutral 40 level for semantic surface use. Use only when a design explicitly requires this neutral step; current ECO evidence is documentation-only.

surface-50.description: Purpose: Provides a strong mid-neutral surface. Suitable for neutral badges and other established high-emphasis neutral fills; avoid as a general page background.

surface-60.description: Purpose: Provides a dark mid-neutral surface. Suitable for size-guide tables, drawer states, notifications, and established stepper treatments; verify text contrast before use.

surface-70.description: Purpose: Provides the neutral 70 level for dark supporting surfaces. Suitable for established footer dividers and related dark compositions; current use is limited.

surface-80.description: Purpose: Provides a dark supporting neutral surface. Suitable for footer sections, dark dividers, and approved controls such as the Sortilog Add action.

surface-90.description: Purpose: Provides a near-black supporting surface within dark compositions. Suitable for established footer areas and social or trust-related elements.

surface-action-1.description: Purpose: Provides the primary action surface. Suitable for primary buttons and other established primary-action treatments.

surface-action-2.description: Purpose: Provides the inverted or light action surface. Suitable for primary inverted buttons, selected tags, and approved light-surface actions.

surface-danger-default.description: Purpose: Provides the strongest danger surface for errors, destructive actions, and workflow-blocking states. Suitable for strong danger badges, notifications, and other high-emphasis danger treatments.

surface-danger-weak.description: Purpose: Provides a medium-emphasis danger surface. Suitable for weak danger badges and concise danger messages where the default surface would be too strong.

surface-danger-weaker.description: Purpose: Provides the lightest danger surface. Suitable for weaker danger badges, notice cards, and notification backgrounds requiring clear meaning without a dominant fill.

surface-disabled.description: Purpose: Identifies unavailable or inactive surfaces. Suitable for disabled controls, sorting interactions, drag handles, and established muted tracks.

surface-information-default.description: Purpose: Provides the strongest informational surface for clear, non-critical messages. Suitable for information badges, notifications, progress indicators, and action-required account statistics.

surface-information-weak.description: Purpose: Provides a medium-emphasis informational surface. Suitable for weak information badges and concise informational messages.

surface-information-weaker.description: Purpose: Provides the lightest informational surface. Suitable for weaker information badges, blockquotes, notifications, and low-emphasis informational areas.

surface-navigation-hover.description: Purpose: Indicates hover on navigational surfaces. Suitable for drawer links, menu items, search navigation, and sorting-section interactions.

surface-opacity-black-05.description: Purpose: Adds a subtle dark translucent interaction layer over light surfaces. Suitable for hover states on secondary and blank buttons.

surface-opacity-black-10.description: Purpose: Adds a light dark-tinted translucent surface. Suitable for tags, selected white chips, and other established 10% overlay treatments.

surface-opacity-black-12.description: Purpose: Adds a 12% dark translucent interaction surface. Suitable for selected and hover states on approved system controls.

surface-opacity-black-20.description: Purpose: Adds a medium dark translucent overlay. Suitable for established card overlays and badge treatments; current use is limited.

surface-opacity-black-50.description: Purpose: Provides a strong dark translucent overlay. Reserved for card treatments requiring substantial image or content dimming; current ECO evidence is documentation-only.

surface-opacity-white-0.description: Purpose: Provides a transparent surface while preserving a semantic fill binding. Suitable for secondary, inverted secondary, blank, inverted blank, and system buttons.

surface-opacity-white-20.description: Purpose: Adds a light translucent interaction layer over dark surfaces. Suitable for approved hover states on primary and inverted actions.

surface-raised-primary.description: Purpose: Provides the default raised surface above an application background. Suitable for cards, inputs, tables, drawers, sorting containers, and other contained content.

surface-raised-secondary.description: Purpose: Provides a secondary raised surface that distinguishes one contained layer from another. Suitable for nested cards, dashboard notices, article containers, and approved secondary layers.

surface-success-default.description: Purpose: Provides the strongest success surface for completed or positive outcomes. Suitable for strong success badges, validation feedback, dashboard cards, and success notifications.

surface-success-weak.description: Purpose: Provides a medium-emphasis success surface. Suitable for weak success badges, dashboard states, and concise positive feedback.

surface-success-weaker.description: Purpose: Provides the lightest success surface. Suitable for weaker success badges, dividers, and low-emphasis success notification backgrounds.

surface-warning-default.description: Purpose: Provides the strongest warning surface for information requiring attention or follow-up. Suitable for warning badges, notifications, ratings, and other high-emphasis warning treatments.

surface-warning-weak.description: Purpose: Provides a medium-emphasis warning surface. Suitable for weak warning badges and concise warning messages.

surface-warning-weaker.description: Purpose: Provides the lightest warning surface. Suitable for weaker warning badges and notification backgrounds requiring attention without a dominant fill.

text-action-accent.description: Purpose: Provides readable action content associated with the active brand accent. Suitable for accent buttons, navigation artwork, icons, and approved brand-accent actions.

text-action-primary.description: Purpose: Provides the default color for primary links and text actions. Suitable for prominent interactive text, breadcrumbs, button labels, and notification actions on light backgrounds.

text-action-primary-hover.description: Purpose: Indicates hover for primary text actions. Suitable for primary links and approved action icons requiring a distinct hover state.

text-action-primary-inverted.description: Purpose: Provides primary interactive text on dark surfaces. Suitable for inverted links, dark navigation, image-backed actions, and approved dark controls.

text-action-primary-inverted-hover.description: Purpose: Indicates hover for primary inverted text actions. Suitable for links and supporting actions on dark surfaces.

text-action-secondary.description: Purpose: Provides a lower-emphasis color for secondary links and text actions. Suitable when an action should align with secondary text hierarchy.

text-action-secondary-hover.description: Purpose: Indicates hover for secondary text actions. Suitable for secondary links; verified ECO use outside documentation is currently limited.

text-action-tertiary.description: Purpose: Provides the lowest-emphasis enabled link color. Suitable for tertiary links, breadcrumbs, carousel actions, and supporting interactions.

text-action-tertiary-hover.description: Purpose: Indicates hover for tertiary text actions. Reserved for tertiary links requiring a distinct hover state; current evidence is documentation-only.

text-danger-default.description: Purpose: Provides prominent danger text that remains effective on very light or dark surfaces. Suitable for larger error titles, labels, required markers, and concise danger messages.

text-danger-on-primary-bg.description: Purpose: Provides danger text for longer messages and smaller text on the primary light background. Suitable where the brighter danger token would be too prominent; current ECO evidence is documentation-only.

text-disabled.description: Purpose: Identifies content belonging to unavailable controls. Suitable for disabled labels, tabs, controls, icons, and related indicators; do not use merely to reduce emphasis.

text-information-default.description: Purpose: Communicates informational status with clear emphasis. Suitable for form guidance, informational messages, status values, badges, and action-required statistics.

text-price-customer.description: Purpose: Identifies customer pricing shown to signed-in users. Suitable for authenticated product pricing, account prices, and associated price tables.

text-price-guest.description: Purpose: Highlights campaign pricing for users who are not signed in. Suitable for guest campaign prices, promotional cards, carousel prices, and related campaign information.

text-price-on-black.description: Purpose: Highlights campaign pricing on black or similarly dark surfaces. Suitable for campaign graphics, splash cards, and approved promotional price content.

text-primary.description: Purpose: Provides the highest-emphasis text on light backgrounds. Suitable for headings, body copy, labels, selection information, and other primary content.

text-primary-inverted.description: Purpose: Provides the highest-emphasis text on dark surfaces and images. Suitable for headings, labels, PDF covers, cards, and body content in inverted contexts.

text-secondary.description: Purpose: Provides secondary-emphasis text on light backgrounds. Suitable for instructions, supporting copy, metadata, and information that should not compete with primary content.

text-secondary-inverted.description: Purpose: Provides secondary-emphasis text on dark surfaces. Suitable for supporting content that should remain readable without competing with primary inverted text.

text-success-default.description: Purpose: Communicates successful or positive status in text and iconography. Suitable for success messages and positive indicators with sufficient background contrast.

text-tertiary.description: Purpose: Provides medium-emphasis text on light backgrounds. Suitable for hints, filter counts, metadata, values, and lower-priority information.

text-tertiary-inverted.description: Purpose: Provides low-emphasis text on dark surfaces. Suitable for footer content, supporting labels, and inverted text with limited visual priority.

text-warning-default.description: Purpose: Communicates warning status in text. Suitable for warning labels and messages on approved light surfaces; current component use is limited.

elevation-b-100.description: Purpose: Creates the strongest general bottom elevation for top-level surfaces that must dominate the interface. Suitable for modal notifications, cookie settings, and other blocking dialogs. Use the designated drawer styles for side drawers.

elevation-b-20.description: Purpose: Creates subtle separation for surfaces that sit only slightly above their surroundings without making them feel like overlays. Suitable for data and variant tables, address and contact cards, inline system notifications, and established compact badges. Avoid for menus, drawers, and modal layers.

elevation-b-40.description: Purpose: Gives compact floating guidance enough separation to remain legible above nearby content. Suitable primarily for tooltips, with limited established use on sticky table headers and compact map or header controls. Use a higher level for menus, toasts, and dialogs.

elevation-b-60.description: Purpose: Creates clear mid-level separation for floating surfaces that must remain distinct from surrounding content. Suitable for headers, main navigation, search surfaces, notifications, and established overflow surfaces. Use b-80 or b-100 when the surface must dominate the layer stack.

elevation-b-80.description: Purpose: Gives high-priority transient surfaces strong separation above page content. Suitable for menus, dropdowns, exposed dropdowns, toast notifications, and mobile navigation layers. Avoid for modal dialogs and horizontally entering drawers.

elevation-drawer-left.description: Purpose: Separates a drawer entering from the left by casting its shadow onto the content at the right edge. Suitable for left-side store-selection and navigation drawers. Do not use for drawers entering from the right.

elevation-drawer-left-menu-sublevel.description: Purpose: Separates nested left-navigation levels by lifting the active submenu above the preceding menu surface. Intended from menu level 2 onward. No verified usage outside documentation is currently recorded, so confirm the pattern before adoption.

elevation-drawer-right.description: Purpose: Separates a drawer entering from the right by casting its shadow onto the content at the left edge. Suitable for product-information, filter, account, notification, cart, review, and delivery-information drawers. Do not use for drawers entering from the left.

elevation-input-control-switch.description: Purpose: Creates a compact raised control surface that makes the movable or selected element feel distinct from its track or container. Suitable for toggle-switch thumbs and the selected option in established segmented controls. Do not use as general component elevation.

elevation-t-100.description: Purpose: Provides the strongest upward-cast elevation for a bottom-anchored surface. No approved usage is currently recorded. Use only when t-80 is demonstrably insufficient and the layer hierarchy has been reviewed.

elevation-t-20.description: Purpose: Provides the lightest upward-cast elevation for a surface anchored below content. No approved usage is currently recorded. Use only after confirming that a subtle top-edge separation is required.

elevation-t-40.description: Purpose: Provides a low upward-cast elevation with more separation than t-20. No approved usage is currently recorded. Reserve for bottom-anchored surfaces that need a light but visible top edge.

Suitable for drawer footers, search drawer footers, and other established sticky footer actions across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

elevation-t-80.description: Purpose: Gives a fixed bottom action area stronger separation when content passes beneath it. Suitable for established drawer and filter-drawer footers that require more emphasis than t-60. Prefer t-60 for the standard footer treatment.

elevation-table-overflow-left.description: Purpose: Signals horizontal table overflow and separates fixed content at the left edge from scrollable middle content. Suitable for established desktop user tables with an overflow column. Use only when content can continue behind the fixed edge.

elevation-table-overflow-right.description: Purpose: Signals horizontal table overflow and separates fixed content at the right edge from scrollable middle content. No verified usage outside documentation is currently recorded. Use only in an approved overflow-table pattern and pair it consistently with the opposite edge.

alt-label-lg.description: Purpose: Introduces or categorizes content before a heading while remaining visually subordinate to it. It can also give important metadata greater visibility. Suitable for article pre-headings, kickers, result counts, selected-item totals, and supplementary headings.

alt-label-md.description: Purpose: Creates a clear layer of secondary context around primary content. It helps users quickly identify category, date, content type, or supporting status. Suitable for card dates, categories, kickers, preheadlines, and supporting drawer information.

alt-label-sm.description: Purpose: Identifies compact, low-emphasis information that supports the interface without attracting unnecessary attention. Suitable for optional labels, rating values, brand identifiers, small metadata, and space-constrained components. Avoid for actions and continuous reading.

body-lg.description: * * This file was generated automatically by Supernova.io and should not be changed manually. * To modify the format or content of this file, please contact your design system team. */ :root { /* Purpose: Creates a spacious, prominent reading experience with a relaxed editorial rhythm. Use when body content should carry visual presence without becoming a heading. Suitable for article paragraphs, lists, card descriptions, introductory guidance, and layouts with ample space. Use it consistently within the same reading flow.

body-md.description: Purpose: Creates an efficient, compact reading experience while maintaining comfortable legibility. Use when content density is important or when body copy must share space with other interface elements. Suitable for complete desktop or mobile articles, lists, tables, notifications, drawers, and general interface copy. Choose between Body Medium and Body Large based on context—not hierarchy.

body-sm.description: Purpose: Supports secondary information without competing with the primary content. Its compact scale helps preserve space while keeping short supporting messages readable. Suitable for helper text, validation messages, status details, prices, captions, and blockquote attribution details. Avoid for primary paragraphs.

body-xl.description: Purpose: Gives introductory or standalone text greater presence than standard body copy while remaining more readable and conversational than a heading. Suitable for introductions, foundation overviews, prominent explanations, and pull quotes. For article preambles, use the Body XLarge Preamble modifier.

display-lg.description: Purpose: Creates the strongest typographic expression in the system and establishes the primary focal point of a page. Suitable for expressive H1 article titles, large heroes, campaigns, component overviews, and major handoff pages. Use either Display Large or Headline XLarge as the primary heading—not both.

display-md.description: Purpose: Creates strong visual impact for branded or promotional content without dominating the entire page. Suitable for medium hero banners, newsletter headings, campaign sections, component showcases, and prominent promotional messages. Keep the text brief.

display-sm.description: Purpose: Adds a distinctive, expressive voice to compact promotional headings. It attracts attention while fitting within smaller components and content regions. Suitable for drawer headers, carousel headings, campaign categories, promotional cards, and small hero banners. Use sparingly.

headline-lg.description: Purpose: Introduces major content sections and creates a strong structural break within a page. It normally represents H2, but may serve as H1 on “My pages.” Suitable for major article sections, page titles, form sections, specification groups, campaign messages, and large card headings.

headline-md.description: Purpose: Establishes a prominent content section and helps divide longer pages into easily recognizable topics. In editorial hierarchy, it represents an H3 heading. Suitable for H3 headings, card titles, token categories, priority labels, and notification headings. Use the dedicated modifier for blockquotes.

headline-sm.description: Purpose: Introduces a compact but clearly defined section of content. It provides stronger hierarchy than a Title while remaining suitable for nested sections. Suitable for H4 headings, smaller article sections, card titles, and component overview headings.

headline-xl.description: Purpose: Establishes the primary subject of a page with strong emphasis while remaining less expressive than Display Large. Suitable for H1 page headings, article titles, and major content sections. Do not combine it with Display Large as a competing primary heading.

label-lg.description: Purpose: Gives important controls and navigation items strong visibility and supports comfortable scanning and interaction. Suitable for medium and large buttons, tabs, navigation items, hero actions, and page-title actions. Avoid for paragraph content.

label-md.description: Purpose: Provides clear and concise text for frequently used controls. It balances visibility with the compactness required by standard interface components. Suitable for small buttons, segmented-control options, form labels, navigation controls, and notification actions.

label-sm.description: Purpose: Communicates compact actions, states, or identifiers with stronger emphasis than an Alt-Label. It is optimized for dense controls and small component surfaces. Suitable for badges, extra-small buttons, segmented controls, citations, and blockquote attribution names.

title-lg.description: Purpose: Separates important subsections and gives prominent component titles a stronger position in the hierarchy. In editorial content, it represents an H5 heading. Suitable for review summaries, larger drawer sections, token examples, documentation groups, and H5 headings.

title-md.description: Purpose: Identifies standard components and smaller subsections with moderate emphasis. In editorial hierarchy, it represents an H6 heading. Suitable for collapsible headings, drawer sections, filters, price groups, tables, icon categories, and H6 headings.

title-sm.description: Purpose: Organizes compact component content and creates a clear local hierarchy without introducing the visual weight of a heading. Suitable for product names, form sections, sorting labels, store details, rating summaries, and footer groups.
